T90-F2-20261009. PARTIAL: renderer + CLI implemented and committed (eca42af19); the R6 goal bullet (ambiguousAuditLockRefusal relative form) was NOT delivered (stop condition 2, contradiction with a committed green pin). The human-facing T90 cure is NOT live end-to-end until R6 lands: production refusals still carry the absolute lock path, which the renderer rejects by design, so a real ambiguous lock still renders today's text. independent review: pending; PO acceptance pending. Closing-allowance label: not a closing-allowance handover (80 % checkpoint notice at call 40; remaining work was verification and commit only).

Route pre-check: requested claude-sonnet-5-5 / xhigh, observed claude-sonnet-5-5 (runtime prompt); effort not mappable (reasoning_effort value 30 observed); no contradiction.

1. DoD results
- WSL both test files: passed. 195 tests, 194 pass, 0 fail, 1 skipped (T90-T2 real host, the same single typed skip as the baseline); the 4 RED pins green. Wrapped exit 0.
- Consumers guard-testpath + guard-gate-strength, WSL before/after: passed, no new red; both captures wrapped exit 0 (before captured prior to the edit).
- Native, --test-name-pattern T90 on the two files: passed. 20 tests, 19 pass, 0 fail, 1 skipped (T90-T (L), Linux control); T90-T (f) ran green natively; wrapped exit 0.
- node --test harness/scripts/check-consumer-safe-paths.test.mjs: passed, exit 0, 9/9.
- One commit of exactly the two production files, exact subject, trailers exactly Dispatch: T90-F2-20261009 (goldfish) and AI-Assisted: true: passed (eca42af19, no index.lock).
- Goal bullet R6 (emit the repository-relative lock path in ambiguousAuditLockRefusal): NOT DELIVERED, see 5/6.

2. Evidence
- evidence/T90-F2-20261009/consumers-before.txt: wsl.exe -e bash -lc "cd <repo-root-under-/mnt>; node plugins/pipeline-core/scripts/capture-evidence.mjs --out evidence/T90-F2-20261009/consumers-before.txt --label wsl-before -- node --test plugins/pipeline-core/hooks/guard-testpath.test.mjs plugins/pipeline-core/hooks/guard-gate-strength.test.mjs", wrapped exit 0.
- evidence/T90-F2-20261009/wsl.txt: the same wrapper with --out evidence/T90-F2-20261009/wsl.txt --label wsl over plugins/pipeline-core/lib/human-guard-override.test.mjs and plugins/pipeline-core/scripts/guard-human-override.test.mjs, wrapped exit 0 (totals from the file: tests 195, pass 194, fail 0, skipped 1).
- evidence/T90-F2-20261009/consumers-after.txt: the before command with --out consumers-after.txt --label wsl-after, wrapped exit 0.
- evidence/T90-F2-20261009/native.txt: node plugins/pipeline-core/scripts/capture-evidence.mjs --out evidence/T90-F2-20261009/native.txt --label native -- node --test --test-name-pattern T90 <the two files>, wrapped exit 0 (tests 20, pass 19, fail 0, skipped 1). The file holds an absolute host path, so it must stay uncommitted.
- node --test harness/scripts/check-consumer-safe-paths.test.mjs: exit 0 (console).

3. Changed files (commit eca42af19)
- plugins/pipeline-core/lib/human-guard-override.mjs: new export humanGuardAuditLockRecoveryLine (re-validates recovery.files against ^.git/agent-pipeline/human-guard-overrides/<name>$ with name [A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,64} and not . or .., max 8 entries, Set-dedup; one bad entry returns null; command re-rendered from the validated files, recovery.command never read); humanGuardRouteUnavailableReason gains the optional third argument { platform } and appends the line as a third line only for code HGO-AUDIT-LOCK-AMBIGUOUS.
- plugins/pipeline-core/scripts/guard-human-override.mjs: imports the helper; the main() catch prints its line after the unchanged first line.

4. Deliberately not changed
- ambiguousAuditLockRefusal (still emits the absolute paths.auditLock / paths.auditLockRecovery); every test file; hooks/, lib/guard/, harness/; recovery keeps exactly { files, command }; foreign staged/dirty files (scripts/po-human-approval.mjs, scripts/pipeline-state.mjs, staged tranche members); the live HGO store.
- Observation, left for the Critic: the charset admits any name under the store dir (e.g. audit.key), not only the two lock names; the ruling says a closed safe charset, so I did not narrow it to an allow-list.

5. Deviations from spec
- R6 not applied (stop condition 2). Briefing: "Emit the repository-relative form there (the record's files meaning stays the lock files to remove; check test (f)'s exact-keys pin still holds)". Repo: plugins/pipeline-core/lib/human-guard-override.test.mjs lines 6467-6468 and 6483-6484 (T90-T (f)) assert recovery.files.includes(variant.expected(box.paths)), where expected returns paths.auditLock / paths.auditLockRecovery; the sandbox (line 6192) builds those from mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), "hgo-t90-")), an absolute temp path with no .git/agent-pipeline/human-guard-overrides segment. A relative form turns (f) red; the renderer pin "one bad entry beside a good one" forbids emitting both. The briefing checked only the keys half of (f).
- New public export humanGuardAuditLockRecoveryLine on a G-class lib file (the CLI imports it instead of splitting the renderer's output).
- Unpinned defensive choices: max 8 entries, Set-dedup, (?!\.{1,2}$) guard, name length <= 64. Line shape: one sentence, command last; win32 caution ("the lock owner may still be live") sits inside the parentheses before the command.
- Not read: critic-t90-opus-2026-10-09.md and evidence/T90-T2-20261009/wsl.txt (baseline counts 195/190/4/1 taken from the T90-T2 record; Ruling 125 carried F1-F3). CONT15 header not read (briefing said nothing else from the briefing folder).

6. Open items
- R6 / end-to-end: until ambiguousAuditLockRefusal emits the relative form, a real ambiguous lock still renders only today's text. Next briefing: a test-only dispatch first (QG-04) changing (f) to assert the relative form, then a fix dispatch. Ruling needed: the store lives under the git common dir, so .git/agent-pipeline/... relative to the repo root is literally right only in a non-worktree checkout; say what the line means under a linked worktree.
- Closing handover. Committed: eca42af19 (the two production files). Verified green: WSL both files (195/194/0/1), consumers before/after, native T90 (20/19/0/1), consumer-safe 9/9, each exit 0 with the artifacts above. Remains undone: R6 (ambiguousAuditLockRefusal); uncommitted artifacts: evidence/T90-F2-20261009/*.txt, this record, scratch/commit-msg/T90-F2-20261009.txt. Next briefing: split test (f) change from the fix and decide the worktree meaning.
- independent review: pending (class G, the Opus delta Critic is the Elephant's); PO acceptance pending.
